title: Claim
description: One typed assertion made by one respondent about a process. Claims are append-only and are the only thing ever written; entities and the process graph are derived from them. Claims never store resolved entity IDs - only raw mention strings - so that re-resolving never requires rewriting a claim.

question_id.description: Which probe from the question bank elicited this. Null for volunteered claims. Enables scoring which questions actually yield, so the bank becomes empirically tuned rather than designed once.

verbatim.description: The exact span the claim was extracted from. Every downstream number must be traceable to a sentence somebody actually said.

verbatim_span.description: [start, end] character offsets in the source transcript.

hedging.description: How firmly it was said. Signal, not metadata: 'about two days, I think' and 'two days' are different observations. 'deferred' = pointed at someone else ('ask Sabine'). 'refused' = declined to answer, which is itself data.

polarity.description: Denials are first-class. 'No, an approver has never rejected one' is the single most valuable answer in the ritual-approval probe and cannot be represented as an assertion.

subject_scope.description: Implements the triangulation rule: a claim about someone else is a hypothesis, promoted to a finding only when that side's own account confirms it. Hearsay claims must never be scored as fact.

entity_refs.description: Raw mention strings awaiting resolution. Resolution lives in a separate revisable layer.

supersedes.description: Claims are append-only. A correction is a new claim superseding an old one, never an edit.

text.description: Exactly as the respondent named it: 'the intake form', 'that PDF thing'.

role.description: Role of this mention within the payload, e.g. 'from', 'to', 'waiting_on'.

quantity.description: A duration expressed as a range, because people say 'a couple of days'. Forcing a point estimate fabricates precision the respondent did not have.

frequency.description: As stated: 'every invoice', 'monthly', 'only when it's over 10k'.

chased.description: Whether the respondent has to chase this handoff. Chasing is a direct marker of constraint #1 and #7.

reformatted.description: Must be restructured before use - direct marker of constraint #4.

copied_to.description: Re-keying target. Copying between systems is the tell for constraint #8.

wins_conflict.description: Whether this system is treated as authoritative when two disagree.

discovered_by.description: How this actor entered the record. 'deferred_to' and 'blamed' mark cast members we have not interviewed yet.

measure.description: touch = hands-on work; elapsed = wall clock start to finish; queue = waiting before work begins. Conflating these is the single most common error in process data.

subject.description: Mention text of what is being measured.

basis.description: 'Usually two days' and 'the last one took three weeks' are different claims. Worst-case anecdotes are often exception-path evidence rather than noise.

owner.description: Not all waiting is ours to delete. A prospect taking three weeks to reply is a real queue no redesign collapses.

current.description: True if reported in the present tense ('right now'), which is the highest-reliability wait evidence.

cadence.description: 'Thursdays', 'month end', 'when we have twenty of them'.

batching.description: Whether work is accumulated before processing. Direct marker of constraint #1 - a cause of queue rather than a measure of it.

driver.description: Why this cadence exists, if stated.

written_down.description: The determinism signal. A statable rule is an unautomated lookup, not judgment - and belongs in code, not a model.

ever_rejected.description: 'no' or 'cant_recall' identifies a pure risk ritual and a deletable step. This is the only reliable probe for constraint #3, which emits no pain signal of its own.

recalled_instances.description: How many distinct instances the respondent produced unprompted. Recall ease is the frequency estimate; it beats a percentage they would have guessed.

borne_by.description: Who is answerable. Accountability is a real function, not a capability gap.

complaint.description: Captured deliberately, then deliberately down-weighted. Findings rank by volume x elapsed, never by complaint intensity - and the eval plants a loud cheap step specifically to test that we ignore it. We must record complaints in order to demonstrate we are not ranking on them.

loops_to.description: Which earlier step the work returns to. Rework travels backward; exceptions travel forward on a different path.

workaround.description: Every shadow spreadsheet is a documented failure of a system of record, and people volunteer them proudly rather than defensively.

compensates_for.description: Which system or step fails such that this is needed.

private.description: Personal vs team-known. Private workarounds are invisible to management and to every system of record.
